messages:
Maria CS: Heads-up — LynxCare (acct lynx-542) reports onboarding slowness. They're starting a 48h APAC pilot tomorrow and need a temporary regional throughput exception + proxy IP allowlist. This is tied to renewal check-in next week; if pilot stalls we risk delaying PO. Can we provision a short-lived bump and add their IPs? Details below.
Maria CS: Request:
- Regions: apac-sin, eu-west-1
- Temp window: 48 hours from 2025-06-05 00:00 UTC
- qps per-key: 12 -> 60
- CIDR: 203.0.113.0/27, 198.51.100.24/32
- Env: staging -> production cutover after pilot
Customer note: they're running parallel batch tests, expect spikes up to 5k rps for a 2 min window.
ops-bot: Ticket created: CS-4589 (provisioning/regional-throughput). Assigned to @Ben Infra.
Ben Infra: Got it. I can do a transient rate window and add CIDRs. Will need a config snippet to apply. @Kayla Network can you confirm the peering punchlist?
Kayla Network: Confirming IPs and peering path. For apac we'll route via sg-edge-peers. I'll update firewall rules. ETA 40m.
Ben Infra: Applying temporary policy now. Use admin cli:
```
redwoodctl ratewindow create --account lynx-542 --regions apac-sin,eu-west-1 --qps 60 --starts 2025-06-05T00:00Z --duration 48h --cidrs 203.0.113.0/27,198.51.100.24/32 --note 'LynxCare pilot temporary bump'
```
deploy-bot: Policy applied in staging cluster (id rw-rate-781). Rolling to production in 15m. :rocket:
Sara SE: I'll join the call with LynxCare ops at 08:30 their local time and monitor. Also capturing feedback re: latency on batch endpoints. Please tag me if any errors show up.
Maria CS: Thanks everyone — please mark auto-revoke after 48h and add renewal flag on account. I'll follow up in renewal tracker. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Auto-revoke scheduled for 2025-06-07T00:00Z. Note added to CS ticket CS-4589.
